info.name: API Reference Associated Persons Policy Import Intents API

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Filters policy import intents by employee ID. Prefixed with `ee_`.

params.name: group_id
params.description: Filters policy import intents by group ID. Prefixed with `g_`.

params.name: status
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `processing`, `failed`, `success`.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of policy import intents. The intents are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent intent appearing first. Results can be filtered by employee ID, group ID, and status.

info.name: Create a new policy import intent

items.docs: Initiates a policy import process for an employee with an existing policy created outside of Kota's systems. This endpoint allows importing policy details for an employee who has an existing policy with one of our existing providers.
